adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/embeddable_host.rb`, the `before_validation` callback unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!`, which will raise `NoMethodError` when `host` is `nil`. The admin controller path (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` with no nil-guard, so a missing/incorrect params envelope can set `host` to nil and trigger a 500 during validation instead of a validation error response.
